description: Perform a virtual craniotomy planning procedure on the loaded CT Cranium scan. 1. Create a bone segmentation mask. 2. Use the Manual Edition tools (Eraser) to cut a surgical window (bone flap) in the Left Parietal or Frontal bone, completely detaching a piece of bone. 3. Separate the detached piece into its own mask or surface. 4. Export the main skull (with the hole) as a 3D surface to '/home/ga/Documents/skull_with_defect.stl'. 5. Export the detached bone piece as a separate 3D surface to '/home/ga/Documents/bone_flap.stl'.
